description: Relative path to the image folder or image file associated with the fabric sample.
missing_value_policy: Required; should point to an existing dataset folder or image path.

description: Stable identifier of the textile fabric sample.
missing_value_policy: Required; must be unique for each fabric sample.

description: Number of visually distinguishable colors in the fabric sample.
allowed_values: Positive integer or empty if unknown
missing_value_policy: Use empty value if unavailable; do not use textual NaN/None markers.

description: Raw supplier or curator notes preserved for traceability.
missing_value_policy: Use empty value only if no notes are available.

description: Fabric weight in grams per square meter.
missing_value_policy: Use empty value if unavailable; numeric cells should not contain units.

description: Pattern or layout category of the fabric sample when available.
missing_value_policy: Use empty value if the pattern is unknown or not annotated.

description: Human-readable normalized fiber composition.
allowed_values: Free text following normalized fiber names
missing_value_policy: Required when composition is known.

description: Percentage of cotton in the fabric composition.
missing_value_policy: Use 0 when cotton is absent; use empty only if composition is unknown.

description: Percentage of wool in the fabric composition.
missing_value_policy: Use 0 when wool is absent; use empty only if composition is unknown.

description: Percentage of linen/flax in the fabric composition.
missing_value_policy: Use 0 when linen is absent; use empty only if composition is unknown.

description: Percentage of silk in the fabric composition.
missing_value_policy: Use 0 when silk is absent; use empty only if composition is unknown.

description: Percentage of viscose in the fabric composition.
missing_value_policy: Use 0 when viscose is absent; use empty only if composition is unknown.

description: Percentage of modal in the fabric composition.
missing_value_policy: Use 0 when modal is absent; use empty only if composition is unknown.

description: Percentage of lyocell in the fabric composition.
missing_value_policy: Use 0 when lyocell is absent; use empty only if composition is unknown.

description: Percentage of acetate in the fabric composition.
missing_value_policy: Use 0 when acetate is absent; use empty only if composition is unknown.

description: Percentage of polyester in the fabric composition.
missing_value_policy: Use 0 when polyester is absent; use empty only if composition is unknown.

description: Percentage of polyamide/nylon in the fabric composition.
missing_value_policy: Use 0 when polyamide is absent; use empty only if composition is unknown.

description: Percentage of elastane/spandex/Lycra in the fabric composition.
missing_value_policy: Use 0 when elastane is absent; use empty only if composition is unknown.

description: Percentage of acrylic/polyacrylic in the fabric composition.
missing_value_policy: Use 0 when acrylic is absent; use empty only if composition is unknown.

description: Percentage of fleece wool/WV when this category is used in the source metadata.
missing_value_policy: Use 0 when absent; review naming before final publication if possible.

description: Percentage of other or unspecified fibers in the fabric composition.
missing_value_policy: Use only when fiber type is known to be outside the listed normalized columns or cannot be separated.

description: Measured fabric thickness in millimeters.
missing_value_policy: Use empty value if unavailable; numeric cells should not contain units.

description: Number of images associated with the fabric sample.
missing_value_policy: Use empty value if image count was not calculated.
